highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates to Skia m152 and adds Graphite GPU bindings across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
highlights_body: This release adds asynchronous pixel readback, restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, strengthens object lifetime handling, and includes broad renderer servicing fixes.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent m151 and m152 servicing fixes, including the Chrome m152 UAF correction.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to adopt the newer rendering architecture.
SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support for non-blocking pixel retrieval.
Restores production of the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for consumers using Silk.NET-based Vulkan interop.
Keeps native pixel sources alive while creating pixmap subsets and derived pixmaps, preventing use-after-free failures.

bullets.lead: Raster image allocation failure no longer leaks memory
bullets.detail: Releases the allocated pixel buffer when SKImage.Create cannot create a raster image.
Roots the source SKRegion while its SpanIterator is in use, preventing a native use-after-free.

bullets.lead: Runtime effect uniform buffers are released on reset
bullets.detail: Disposes the previous uniform buffer when SKRuntimeEffectUniforms is reset.
Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server deployments.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-backed font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved MSVC environment initialization for native builds
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m152 update, Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel readback, and the restored Vulkan Silk.NET package.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 added renderer servicing fixes, lifecycle corrections, and packaging improvements before the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzz shaping by avoiding an unnecessary feature-array copy and fixes the non-memory-backed stream path used to create blobs.
